name: Figueroth Faeth
source: Fig Faeth — well, Fig's fine with Kristen actually. Not only are they close friends in the same adventuring party living in the same house, Fig is the paladin for Kristen's deity's wife. Cassandra's only cleric and Ankarna's only paladin sounds like a match made in hell, except things are totally platonic between Fig and Kristen. Besides, Fig has Ayda!
